style_guide: Professional 2.5D isometric game sprite (2:1 dimetric projection, 26.565° angle). Appears 3D while being 2D. Clean hard-edged pixel art, sharp black outlines, flat cel-shading with 2-3 tone depth (highlight/mid/shadow), single square tile footprint per building, no perspective distortion, orthographic camera, seamless tileable base, AAA indie game asset quality, style of SimCity 2000 + Factorio + Oxygen Not Included.
negative_prompt_base: blurry, photorealistic, watermark, text, real life, detailed texture, complex scene, multiple buildings, gradient, soft lighting, 3D render, perspective, fisheye, lens distortion, bloom, motion blur, depth of field, noisy, dithering, anti-aliasing, photographic, anime, cartoon
